# Top React UI Libraries

July 20, 2026 Updated weekly 50 entries

This ranking measures React UI library popularity based on GitHub stars, reflecting developer adoption and community engagement with component libraries designed for React applications. The scores represent the total number of stars each repository has accumulated on GitHub, indicating both current usage and long-term developer trust.

The React component ecosystem continues to evolve rapidly, with enterprise-focused solutions like Ant Design dominating with nearly 98,000 stars, while modern alternatives like Chakra UI and React Bits compete for developer mindshare in the 40,000-star range. These rankings reveal a clear trend toward comprehensive design systems and developer experience optimization, as teams seek battle-tested components that can accelerate product development while maintaining consistency across applications. The significant gap between top-tier libraries and emerging solutions highlights how network effects and community contributions drive adoption in the open-source UI component space.
